$comment: Single source of truth for the Calendar API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A month grid for picking a date or a range, with full keyboard support.

value / defaultValue.description: "YYYY-MM-DD", or { from, to } for a range. Strings never shift a day across time zones.

month / defaultMonth.description: The month shown, "YYYY-MM". Defaults to the chosen date's month, else today's.

min / max.description: Earliest and latest dates that can be chosen.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Click a day, or use the arrow keys and Enter. In HTML, add data-vin-calendar and include vinui.js once.

examples.title: Range
examples.description: The first click starts the range, the second ends it.

examples.title: Limits
examples.description: Only weekdays between two dates, with weeks starting on Sunday.

a11y: Follows the WAI-ARIA date grid pattern: a table with role="grid", labelled by the month, with the chosen days marked aria-selected.
Only one day takes Tab; arrow keys move by day and week, Home and End to the start and end of the week, PageUp and PageDown by month (with Shift, by year).
Every day has a full label ("Saturday, November 14, 2026"), today is marked aria-current="date", and the month name is announced when it changes.
Days that can't be chosen stay focusable (aria-disabled), so keyboard users can move past them.
Arrow keys follow the reading direction in right-to-left pages.
